Flypage now ejects the scanner when you are done.

## Changes

- When the processing window closes, the scanner is ejected: its memory is unmounted and the device is powered off, like *Safely Remove* in the file manager. The end notification says when the scanner can be unplugged, or why it could not be ejected (for example, a file on it is still open in another program).
- Ejecting can be turned off for each scanner: in Settings → Scanners, open the scanner and turn off *Eject the scanner when the window closes*. It is on by default, including for scanners set up with an earlier version.

## Install (Debian 13 "trixie" or later)

```sh
sudo apt install ./flypage_0.1.3_all.deb
```

When upgrading from an earlier version, the same command replaces the installed one. Log out and back in afterwards (or restart the background service), so that the scanner watcher runs the new version.

To check the download: `sha256sum -c flypage_0.1.3_all.deb.sha256`
